WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT cc.CustomerID, cc.Segment, cc.total_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption mc ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = mc.min_consumption
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) / COUNT(CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS "SME - LAM",
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS "LAM - KAM",
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS "KAM - SME"
